turns.user_prompt: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's hair color to blue.

turns.editing_prompt: Change the person's hair color to blue. Preserve the person's identity, hair shape, and all other aspects of the video.

turns.user_prompt: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.

turns.editing_prompt: Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images, using the references only for the hairstyle shape. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.

Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.

turns.editing_prompt: Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.
